newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia pleased with rating, sees cheaper new debt.
newsitem.headline: Croatia pleased with rating, sees cheaper new debt.

text.p: The Croatian government said it was very pleased with credit ratings awarded it by Standard & Poor's and IBCA on Friday, and officials were confident the ratings would help attract investment from abroad.
S&P and IBCA both assigned a BBB minus long-term foreign currency rating to Croatia and S&P said it had assigned its A minus (A-) long-term local currency rating.
"This is an explicit acknowledgment of Croatia's policies and its macroeconomic and political position in the world," Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa told a news conference.

Top officials also said a stable outlook indicated the rating could be upgraded with time and further reduce the price of the country's future borrowing. The invesment grade was also expected to draw serious institutional investors.
"What it means in concrete terms is a sharp decline in interest rates," said Finance Minister Bozo Prka.
The government plans to raise $500 million abroad for reconstruction spending that was approved by parliament as part of this year's almost 40 billion kuna ($7.2 billion) budget.
It is about to launch a $250 million issue of dollar-denominated Eurobonds which will be led by Merrill Lynch and Union Bank of Switzerland.
Although pricing still has to be determined, officials said there was a keen interest for bonds among foreign investors, particularly from the Far East.
They indicated the spread might be half of the 1.75 percent over Libor which is paid on the 200 million German mark syndicated loan arranged by Dresdner Bank in 1996.
With the rating Croatia has climbed significantly up the list of sovereign borrowers. It now ranks 40th, ahead of Slovakia, Greece and Hungary, officials said.
An assessment from Moody's rating agency, seen very much in line with those already obtained, is expected very soon.
"There won't be any surprises," Prka told Reuters. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
